summary: The RptMnuNextAssignmentReport is a web user control implemented in C# as part of the HSPnet system. It generates a report detailing the next assignments based on specified parameters.
purpose: To facilitate the generation and display of a 'Next Assignment Report' within a web application, allowing users to select parameters and view the report in HTML or download it as an Excel file.

workflows.name: Generate Next Assignment Report
steps: User selects the start and end dates using calendar controls.
System verifies the selected dates with validators.
User selects agencies to be included in the report.
User clicks 'Run Excel' to generate the report.
System calls the stored procedure 'ReportGoneTo' with parameters.
System formats data into a CSV report.
System displays the report in HTML and offers an Excel download.

business_rules: Dates must be valid and within the expected range.
system_behavior: On async postback, JavaScript setup is initiated.
On 'Run Excel' button click, parameters are set and the report is generated.
